page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: running head at the top with page number 252, then a full-width heading, then a synopsis diagram (braces and boxes) with a vertical label at the left edge and a short line "ARGV." at its lower right. Right page: mostly cut off by the right edge of the scan, with only fragments of headings and margin text visible.

main_text.head: SYNOPSIS EPISTOLÆ AD Galatas.
main_text.l: In Epistolam ad Gal. parte principali agit Paul.[?]
Reprehendens primò inconstantiam Galatarum, & Pseudoapostolorum perversitatem: cap. 1. à v. 6. usque ad 13.
Christianismo: à v. 16. capitis primi, usque ad v.15. capitis secundi.
Probare instituit cap. 2. v. 15. in illa sua ad Petrum sermocinatione. usque ad finem cap.
Persequitur: Ostendens Fide in Christum iustificari electos, & nô bonis operibus Legis
tum ceremonialis quam docet abrogatam esse: cap.4.
Concludit: de libertate, per Christum partâ amplectenda, cap. 5. usque ad v. 13.
De bono ope-rib. exhortationes ad officia Christianorum
generalia: contra licentiam carnis, &c: c.5. à v.13. usque ad finé.
Specialia, tum inferiorum, tum superiorum, c.6. usque ad v.11. ubi conclusio epist. incipit.

page.notes: The right printed page is cut off by the right edge of the scan. Only fragments of its headings and margin text are visible, so none of it could be read reliably and nothing from it is transcribed. The vertical label at the left edge is hard to read; the reading "In Epistolam ad Gal. parte principali agit Paul." is uncertain. The brace structure is hard to follow in places. Levels follow the visual grouping as best I could judge, and the placement of "De reipsa" and "De sua persona" relative to the outer braces is uncertain. "antea-tam" is a line-break split; the full word is probably "antequam", but I read only "tam" with confidence. The line "De bono ope-rib. exhortationes" is split across lines and partly obscured; the exact hyphenation is uncertain. "ARGV" at the lower right is partly cut off; the final letters are uncertain.
